# PearlOS UI Spec: Workflow Components

Role: UI Component Designer
Date: 2026-04-22

This document defines React component specs for the PearlOS workflow UI. Components are mobile first, use functional React with hooks, and prefer Tailwind CSS. Avoid `any` types in TypeScript. No em dashes.

Color tokens:
- Design: #3B82F6
- Code: #10B981
- Art: #8B5CF6
- QA: #F59E0B

Global style notes:
- Use `flex-col` as the default layout direction.
- Use `clamp()` for font sizes to keep mobile readable.
- Use `rounded-full` for capsules and pills.
- Use subtle shadows only where needed for affordance.
- Icons should be 16 to 20 px on mobile, 20 to 24 px on desktop.

## 1) MagicWandButton
Purpose: A top right action button on notes that sends the note to Launchpad.

Placement:
- Anchor to the top right of the note header or container.
- Keep 12 px minimum touch padding around the hit area.

Behavior:
- On click, triggers `onSendToLaunchpad(noteId)`.
- Show loading state while sending.
- Optional tooltip on hover for desktop: "Send to Launchpad".

Props:
- `noteId: string`
- `onSendToLaunchpad: (noteId: string) => Promise<void> | void`
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `isLoading?: boolean`

Visual:
- Shape: circular button, 40 px default size.
- Background: `bg-white/80` with `backdrop-blur` over notes.
- Border: `border border-black/10`.
- Icon: magic wand, `text-slate-700`.
- Hover: `bg-white`, `shadow-sm`.
- Active: `scale-95`.

Accessibility:
- `aria-label="Send to Launchpad"`.
- Loading state uses `aria-busy`.

## 2) AgentCapsule
Purpose: Colorful pill that displays an agent thought summary.

Placement:
- Inline in task cards, or below task title.
- Wraps to the next line on small screens.

Behavior:
- Optional expand on tap to show full thought text.
- Collapsed by default on mobile with `line-clamp-1`.

Props:
- `agentName: string`
- `thought: string`
- `variant: "design" | "code" | "art" | "qa"`
- `isExpandable?: boolean`

Visual:
- Shape: pill, `rounded-full`.
- Padding: `px-3 py-1`.
- Typography: `text-[clamp(12px,3.2vw,14px)]`.
- Background color by variant:
  - Design: `bg-[#3B82F6]/15` with `text-[#3B82F6]`.
  - Code: `bg-[#10B981]/15` with `text-[#10B981]`.
  - Art: `bg-[#8B5CF6]/15` with `text-[#8B5CF6]`.
  - QA: `bg-[#F59E0B]/15` with `text-[#F59E0B]`.
- Optional left dot: `h-2 w-2 rounded-full` using the solid color.

Accessibility:
- Use a `button` element if expandable.
- Provide `aria-expanded` when toggleable.

## 3) TaskProgressBar
Purpose: Shows task progress from 0 to 100 percent and ETA.

Placement:
- Under task title, above metadata.

Behavior:
- Animates width when progress changes.
- Show ETA as text on the right, smaller font.

Props:
- `value: number` // 0 to 100
- `eta?: string` // "5m", "2h", or formatted time
- `status?: "running" | "paused" | "complete" | "error"`

Visual:
- Height: 6 px.
- Track: `bg-black/5`.
- Fill color by status:
  - Running: `bg-[#3B82F6]`.
  - Paused: `bg-black/30`.
  - Complete: `bg-[#10B981]`.
  - Error: `bg-red-500`.
- Rounded ends: `rounded-full`.
- ETA: `text-[clamp(11px,3vw,12px)]` in `text-slate-500`.

Accessibility:
- `role="progressbar"` with `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`.

## 4) ParentTaskCard
Purpose: Expandable card that contains a parent task with child tasks.

Behavior:
- Click header to expand and collapse children.
- Persist expanded state in local state, optionally controlled.
- Show child count in header.

Props:
- `title: string`
- `description?: string`
- `childrenCount: number`
- `defaultExpanded?: boolean`
- `isExpanded?: boolean`
- `onToggle?: (next: boolean) => void`
- `children: React.ReactNode`

Visual:
- Card: `rounded-2xl border border-black/10 bg-white`.
- Padding: `p-4` on mobile, `p-5` on larger screens.
- Header layout: title on left, expand chevron on right.
- Title: `text-[clamp(16px,4.6vw,20px)]` `font-semibold`.
- Description: `text-[clamp(13px,3.6vw,15px)]` `text-slate-600`.
- Child area: `mt-3 space-y-2`.

Accessibility:
- Header is a `button` with `aria-expanded`.

## 5) ChildTaskCard
Purpose: Compact row showing agent status for a child task.

Behavior:
- Can be clickable to open details.
- Shows status dot, agent name, short status text, and optional progress.

Props:
- `agentName: string`
- `statusText: string`
- `variant: "design" | "code" | "art" | "qa"`
- `progress?: number`
- `onClick?: () => void`

Visual:
- Layout: horizontal with `items-center` and `gap-3`.
- Height: 48 to 56 px.
- Background: `bg-white` with `border border-black/5`.
- Status dot: 8 px using variant color.
- Agent name: `text-[clamp(13px,3.6vw,15px)]` `font-medium`.
- Status text: `text-[clamp(12px,3.2vw,14px)]` `text-slate-500`.
- Optional progress: mini bar 3 px high, same color as variant.

Accessibility:
- If clickable, use `button` with `aria-label` including agent name.

Notes:
- All components should be TypeScript and avoid `any`.
- Keep layout mobile first, `flex-col` where possible.
- Use Tailwind utilities consistently with the rest of the codebase.
EOF
